name: Amplemarket
tagline: All-in-one AI sales platform with Duo, a copilot for finding and engaging buyers.
description: Amplemarket is an all-in-one AI sales platform for finding prospects, personalizing outreach, and running multichannel campaigns. Its AI copilot, Duo, detects buying signals across millions of data points — job changes, website visits, and competitor signals — researches accounts, and builds personalized multichannel sequences across email, calls, social, and AI voice notes, learning from rep feedback.
insight: Founded in 2018 by three Portuguese physicists; raised a $12M Series A co-led by Comcast Ventures and Armilar.
edge: Signal-driven prospecting (Duo) ties intent detection directly into personalized sequences — strong for data/signal-led outbound over volume-first tools.

references.title: Amplemarket Raises $12 Million in Series A
